name: lut-studio
description: A darkroom-style photo editor that runs entirely in the browser: develop RAW files with a Lightroom-style panel (white balance, tone, presence, histogram, auto tone), then stack 64 generated LUT looks or import your own .cube. Full-resolution JPEG export — no accounts, no server-side processing.

scripts.test:tone: node scripts/test-tone-curve.mjs && node scripts/test-tone-model.mjs && node scripts/test-local-laplacian.mjs && node scripts/test-camera-look.mjs && node scripts/test-auto-tone.mjs && node scripts/test-renderer-sampling.mjs
scripts.predeploy: npm run build:luts && npm run build:gz && npm run build:site
